steps.message: What is my next upcoming event in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the title only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.

Execute: adb shell 'date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z"; echo "TZ=$(getprop persist.sys.timezone)"; pm list packages | grep -Ei "simple|calendar"; now=$(date +%s000); end=$((now+31536000000)); echo "RANGE_MS:$now-$end"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$now/$end --projection title:begin:end:event_id --sort "begin ASC"'
